basic_info.description: The views don't get much better than this!  Enjoy ever-changing vistas of the San Francisco Bay from this iconic mid-century building.  Expansive sliding window walls flood the residence with abundant natural light, seamlessly connecting the interior to the outdoors.  The living space opens onto a private exterior deck - the perfect spot to savor morning coffee or unwind with evening beverages while taking in the scenery.  The bedroom showcases sweeping San Francisco skyline views stretching from the Bay Bridge to Sutro Tower. Garage parking, extra storage.  Building amenities include: Secure Doorman building, laundry on every floor, swimming pool, guest parking, BBQ, community room, car wash area and bike storage. Monthly HOA of $1213 includes PGE, water, heat, refuse, common area maintenance and insurance and reserves. Ideally located near Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, The Marina, shopping and transportation, the home offer unparalleled acces to the city's best amenities. Take a short stroll to the many vibrant shops and restaurants along Polk, Chestnut and Union Streets, as well as North Beach.  From your home, enjoy front row seats to Fleet Week and all the happenings on the Bay.
